constraints: angles below 0 or beyond one full turn; reduce to a coterminal angle first; degree inputs are multiples of 15
hints: Add or subtract complete turns in the given unit until the signed angle lies in one standard turn.
Locate the terminal ray’s quadrant. Its reference angle is the acute gap to the nearest ray of the horizontal axis.
In Quadrant I use the angle itself. In II, III and IV use half-turn minus angle, angle minus half-turn, and full-turn minus angle, respectively. Keep the requested unit.
